name: human-allegory-engine
title_zh: 把人类行为转译成可调用的寓言引擎
tagline_zh: 写代码时想引用一个典故，却总卡在“那个故事叫什么来着”？这个引擎把寓言变成函数，输入场景即得隐喻。
tagline_en: Coding and need a classic allusion but blanking on the name? This engine turns fables into callable.
why_zh: 它不存故事，而是把寓言拆成“角色-冲突-转折”结构，按你的输入动态重组，输出带出处和适用边界。
why_en: It doesn't store tales—it decomposes fables into role-conflict-turn structures and recombines them dynamically, outputting with.
limit_zh: 只覆盖中西方常见寓言约200条，冷门典故会返回“无匹配”；输出是隐喻建议，不保证文学性；需要联网拉取词源，离线不可用。
limit_en: Covers ~200 common fables only; obscure ones return 'no match'. Outputs are metaphor suggestions, not literary prose. Requires network for.
